2608.04519.title: Leak-Resistant Unlearning: A New Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Consistency and Recovery Robustness
2608.04519.paper_summary: Benchmarking machine unlearning methods is critical to understand whether sensitive knowledge is removed from large language models (LLMs) or not. Current unlearning benchmarks include mainly single-hop questions and a narrow set of multi-hop questions. Although effective, they still face two challenges. (1) Knowledge is not isolated, whereby diverse multi-hop reasoning paths can potentially induce knowledge leakage than normal queries. (2) Unlearning may be fragile: unlearned knowledge can be partially recovered through recovery attacks such as lightweight post-unlearning adaptation, making static evaluation insufficient. Therefore, in this paper, we introduce \unlearning as a novel benchmark to understand robust LLM knowledge removal across diverse reasoning paths and recovery attacks. We experiment with this benchmark on 3 models, 6 unlearning methods, and 2 carefully curated datasets. Results show that existing methods are vulnerable to multi-hop reasoning paths and recovery attacks. We further explore the trade-off among forget quality, robustness, and model utility for LLM unlearning.
2608.04519.paper_summary_zh: 基準測試機器去學習方法對於理解敏感知識是否從大型語言模型 (LLMs) 中移除至關重要。目前的去學習基準主要包括單跳問題和一組狹窄的多跳問題。儘管有效，但它們仍面臨兩個挑戰。(1) 知識並非孤立，因為多樣的多跳推理路徑可能比正常查詢更容易引發知識洩漏。(2) 去學習可能是脆弱的：透過輕量級的去學習後適應等恢復攻擊，去學習的知識可能會部分恢復，這使得靜態評估不足。因此，在本文中，我們介紹 \unlearning 作為一個新穎的基準，以理解在多樣的推理路徑和恢復攻擊中穩健的 LLM 知識移除。我們在 3 個模型、6 種去學習方法和 2 個精心策劃的數據集上對這個基準進行實驗。結果顯示，現有方法對多跳推理路徑和恢復攻擊是脆弱的。我們進一步探討 LLM 去學習中遺忘質量、穩健性和模型效用之間的權衡。
